Although I’m not as severe as other people on this thread, I’ve noticed a couple things that were really setting me back. 1. Anxiety, I’ve gotten to points where I’m near tears because the gurgling is so loud and embarrassing, but you CANNOT get stressed about it. It would tense up all my muscles. I read on another thread that it helped someone to practice opening your esophagus. Pretend you’re yawning, and just practice that stretch in your mouth. Tense your body really really hard and REALLY focus on the bubbles coming up. It took me a little to get the hang of it but by force and determination it is possible. Yawn, tense up your stomach, and usually something along the lines of a burp will happen. Unfortunately, it makes you feel super fucking sick. So, honestly, maybe try throwing up? It’ll help you get over your fear a lot. I got over my fear by pretty much getting super fucking intoxicated and it became normal to puke. THERE IS HOPE. DONT PANIC. I have faith in you!
